'''2013 SoCal Grand Prix Day 1 Kevin Shannon LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Kevin Shannon]] at [[2013 SoCal Grand Prix]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
